items.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: And we had Orr and Joe Oliver and Martin, Orr, pretty good sized band

ctx.x: We passed through there, Max, and they looked like Jesus was coming through. A man who looked like Jesus.

That was Orr's brother. He heard the, you see, when we were going to some little town up in Louisiana to play the show, give a show and a dance. And we had Orr and Joe Oliver and Martin, Orr, pretty good sized band, about five, six, seven maybe. And when they got to this farm, this cane farm where Orr's brother lived, where they played some music, see. Oh yeah. And they'd come Orr's brother to run into the cane. That's what she's talking about. And he ran through the sugar cane, you know.
Parting the cane. Parting the cane coming through and had long beards. And somebody, I think it was Joe Oliver, said, well here comes Jesus. He looked just like Jesus.
